description: For an EU Directive, the national implementing measures (NIM) that each member state has notified to the European Commission — the Publications Office's own transposition tracker, read live from CELLAR. Give a CELEX number (e.g. "32019L1937" for the Whistleblower Directive), the "2019/1937" short form, or a common name (e.g. "Whistleblower Directive", "GDPR"). For a Directive, returns every member state with its measure(s) — title, type of act, document date, notification date, national Official Journal citation — and member states with NO recorded measure are listed explicitly as "none recorded", never dropped. A member state can notify dozens of measures (France has 36 for the Whistleblower Directive, Czechia 80, Croatia 93), mixing the actual transposing act with older provisions CELLAR also links — CELLAR itself does not flag which measure is "the" one, so measures within each state are ordered by how closely a measure's own title echoes the directive's own title (read in whichever language scores best), then by newest document date, which in practice surfaces the real transposing act first or near first; `limit_per_state` (default 10) then truncates that ranked list, with `truncated: true` meaning more exist. Where a live Pipeworx national-legislation pack covers that state (Germany/de-gesetze, Austria/at-ris, Italy/it-normattiva, Netherlands/nl-wetten, France/france-legi, Spain/boe-legislacion) the matching pack and tools are named so you can drill into the actual provision text — no SPARQL required anywhere in this chain. A Regulation is answered directly: regulations are not transposed (Article 288 TFEU), so this says that plainly rather than returning an empty list.

directive.description: CELEX number ("32019L1937"), short form ("2019/1937"), or common name ("Whistleblower Directive", "GDPR").

limit_per_state.description: Max measures listed per member state before truncation (default 10, max 50). Some directives have dozens of related national measures per state.

member_state.description: Optional: restrict to one EU member state — English name, ISO2 ("DE"), or ISO3 ("DEU"). Omit to get all 27.
